comment: Output index order matches panel order top to bottom, 1x through 8x, confirmed against census outputPos (y 140 to 297 in index order). The counters are free-running: counters[i] starts at i+1, is decremented on every trigger and reloaded to i+1 when it reaches zero (src/DivTrig.cpp:85-88), so the divisions are counted from the module's start or its last reset. A reset returns from process() immediately (src/DivTrig.cpp:71), so a trigger landing in the same sample as a reset is lost. Probability defaults to 0.5 (src/DivTrig.cpp:51), which is why a newly placed module already drops half its pulses. Nothing in the plugin is polyphonic.
